opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members holding an eligible category (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; applications limited to one per department with Head of Department support. Students, Affiliates and Partner Scientists not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early-career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months covering chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences. Prioritises projects engaging under-represented audiences, developing RSC members' engagement skills, supporting positive social outcomes, and connecting families/intergenerational audiences with chemistry. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants can be PhD students or researchers at any career stage, working in any sector or location. Must be an Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) of the RSC before submitting and for the duration of the grant. Undergraduate Student Members, Affiliates and Partner Scientists not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Funds research visits to collaborator institutions and organising meetings/workshops. Up to £5000. Round 2 applications open 3 August 2026, close 21 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicant must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; must have an active role in the event (except structured training/professional development programmes).
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs incurred for care they usually provide (e.g. extra home help, nursing care, travel for a relative to accompany them). Up to £1,200 per year. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicant must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will use funds to cover or partially cover the cost of support relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event (except structured training/professional development programmes).
opportunities.summary: Supports individuals with disabilities and ongoing health conditions to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering the cost of specific support such as accessible travel/accommodation, personal assistance, communication support, assistive software or hardware. Up to £1,200 per year. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.
